findings.rationale: Accepted. Decision A: must_pass no longer carries command text; it names checks declared in a repo-owned committed registry (or autopilot-shipped checks), so a rule list cannot run arbitrary code; every path field is repo-relative, normalised, no .. or absolute, realpath-contained.

Accepted. Decision B: no lane-keyed files. The switch binds to the worker: headless rails write the gate file keyed by the CHILD_SESSION_ID they generate and remove it on worker exit, expiry = rail timeout; native subagents key on the worker worktree realpath only if P0 proves the hook sees it, otherwise the native path is excluded explicitly. Block counters keyed per worker.

Accepted. Decision F: correct the hook descriptions against hooks/per-turn-gate.js and cite or label every load-bearing claim; dispatch-author.sh:1388 does pass --session-id, but the id is generated inside the rail, so depth-0 cannot write a session file before dispatch (handled by B).

Accepted. Decision E: the change arm uses a candidate guidance paragraph frozen in the eval directory; P4 commits that exact text after PASS; arms, file list, G3 turns, G4 carrier and cost table reconciled.
